items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I worked for a whole year with Frank Weingard... I told Frank I had them all memorized. And he used to tell people that... he fired me... he said, 'You can stay in the band.'

ctx.x: They probably were. So you went back with Winegar then.

Yes. We finished out that engagement. Then Frank really didn't go anyplace from there. He was a very nice man. One of the things -- he had had infantile paralysis, and he had one leg that was, you know, very badly deformed, small, and he wore a metal brace there. And he used to horrify us. He'd yell up to the trombone player, "Throw me the oil, " and then he'd roll up his leg and squirt the trombone oil on the brace, and -- I don't know.
At what point did you begin playing tenor saxophone?
